{{Vanilla|Woodland Mansion}}
A '''woodland mansion''' generates as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes its chest loot and one of its rooms.

== Structure ==
The spider room <code>woodland_mansion/1x1_as2</code> is replaced. Its spider spawner spawns spiders tagged <code>NoDrops</code>, which drop nothing, like other spawner mobs in the pack (see [[Spawner]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/structure/woodland_mansion/1x1_as2.nbt}}</ref>

The [[Archaeologist]] sells Mansion Maps at level 5. See [[Explorer maps]].
